name: Ganaanaam Tva Ganapatim
text:
ॐ गणानां त्वा गणपतिं हवामहे कविं कवीनामुपमश्रवस्तमम् ।
ज्येष्ठराजं ब्रह्मणां ब्रह्मणस्पत आ नः शृण्वन्नूतिभिः सीद सादनम् ॥
meaning: We invoke Ganapati, the seer among seers, renowned and foremost. Hear our praise and take your seat among us.
supports: Eloquence; learning; clear intention; respectful communication.
when: Before a learning session or public speaking.
